newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Train crash disrupts Dutch rail traffic.
newsitem.headline: Train crash disrupts Dutch rail traffic.

text.p: A collision between a passenger train and a goods train disrupted rail traffic in western parts of the Netherlands on Thursday.

No one was injured when an intercity train carrying 22 passengers from Amsterdam to The Hague collided with a goods train near the city of Leiden, but six carriages of the passenger train were derailed.

The Dutch national rail company said services between Amsterdam and the Hague would remain disrupted for the rest of the day, but international services between Amsterdam and Brussels and Paris would be diverted around the affected area.
The cause of the accident was not yet known.
